planets.name: TOI-677 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-677 with a 11.2-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-677 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-677. Its orbit and size follow Jordán et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname HU_ET_AL__2024): disc_year 2020, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 11.2365985, pl_radj 1.17, pl_bmassj 1.234

quotes.title: TOI-677 b
quotes.card: TOI-677 b (TOI-677b) is a warm super-Jupiter type exoplanet orbiting the F-type main sequence star TOI-677 in the constellation of Ophiuchus about 466 ly (143 pc) away from Earth.
quotes.introduction: The mass of the planet has been found to be 1.252 Jupiter masses and the radius of the planet is 1.179 Jupiter radii.
